split: Half of each native CFA phase; reverse and require both z>t
selection: Nuisance, variance estimate, frequency, phase and amplitude use discovery subset only
threshold_selection: Fixed descriptive sweep; no thresholds chosen on validation or test
reference_role: Exact procedural targets used only to draw sensor observations and score corrections
scope: Restricted grid sines and step family; misspecified off-grid edge stress. No neural baseline, DINO, target-assisted discovery, protected photo access, RAW decoding or GPU work. Noise is independent Poisson plus Gaussian read, without ADC/clipping/correlations. Nominal z uses discovery-only plug-in variances; not calibrated probabilities. Two repeat patches share a source; source-level uncertainty is not estimated here. Wave corrections are analytic scalar CFA predictions, not a restored RGB model.
